verdictStatement: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. CLAUDE-PTLJ-V1-SF1 is landed precisely and without collateral. OBL-ADVISORY-HONESTY is added carrying all four advisories D-125 names — CLAUDE-V45-A1, A2, A3 and CLAUDE-D125-A1 — each of which I located in live bytes rather than accepting on assertion; summary gains the honesty bucket; the class is correctly typed as leftoverDesign false, rideStanding honesty, not SATISFIED and not discharged; and recordedInputs now pins the D-125 adversarial review where the fourth advisory actually lives, so the source is anchored. The repair carries no regression: all six pre-existing obligations and all ten pre-existing summary fields are == identical to v1, one doesNot line was added and none removed, and basedOn gained only predecessorJoin, so purpose's claim that the rest of the measurement is unchanged is exactly true. All 19 cited path/digest pairs measure equal with zero mismatches, recordedInputs.HEAD agrees with the top-level head and live HEAD as the artifact's own invariant requires, namedCorpusNotAuthored is == exact to live G22 v1, DR-126 leftover-design is not claimed closed, v45 is not applied, nothing is populated, no DR-G* row is added, required-now is 26, v1 is unmoved at 757351a1 with its version number not reused, and the subject did not move. Four further refutations of my own — that the repair is cosmetic, that a measurement was quietly changed, that a specifiedNotLeftover class is still missing, and that the predecessor's standing is overstated — all failed against live bytes.
